# Google's sign-in button

`sign-in-with-google-dark.svg` is Google's own "Sign in with Google" button,
dark theme, square, with text, for Android and Web. It is the file
`Android + Web/SVG/Dark/Theme=Dark, Show text=Yes, Shape=Square, Platform=Android+Web.svg`
from Google's `signin-assets.zip`
(https://developers.google.com/static/identity/images/signin-assets.zip),
downloaded on 2026-11-21 and not changed.

It is a third-party mark used as Google's branding rules require
(DESIGN.md section 8), not a Heap Academy asset.
